routes.summary: 逐步演示二分查找：每次取中点，比较目标，丢掉一半。四个变体：有序数组、含重复、旋转、旋转且含重复。
routes.introZh: 在已经排好序的序列里，每次只看中点，然后丢掉不可能包含目标的那一半。选一个变体，点一个数作为目标，再一步一步往下走。
routes.introEn: In a sorted sequence, each step looks at the midpoint and discards the half that cannot hold the target. Choose a variant, pick a target, and walk the search one step at a time.

routes.titleSuffix: 有序数组上的二分查找
routes.summary: 在递增数组 0 到 9 上逐步演示二分查找，标出低位、中点和高位，并高亮当前代码行。
routes.introZh: 数组已经从小到大排好。中点比目标小，就把左界移到中点右边；比目标大，就把右界移到中点左边。
routes.introEn: The array is sorted ascending. If the midpoint is smaller than the target, the left bound moves just past it. If it is larger, the right bound moves just before it.

routes.summary: 在含有重复数字的有序数组上演示二分查找：先跳过两端连续的重复值，再取中点比较。
routes.introZh: 两端如果贴着相同的数字，先把边界挪过这段重复，再取中点。这样中点不会一直落在同一片相同的值上。
routes.introEn: When either end sits on a run of equal values, the bound steps past that run before the midpoint is taken, so the search does not stay inside the same plateau.

routes.titleSuffix: 旋转有序数组上的二分查找
routes.summary: 在旋转后的有序数组上演示二分查找：中点与目标不在同一段时，先把中点值映到极值再比较。
routes.introZh: 数组在某个位置断开后又接上，例如 4 5 6 7 8 9 0 1 2 3。中点和目标如果一个在前半段、一个在后半段，就先把中点当成极大或极小，再决定丢掉哪一半。
routes.introEn: The sorted array has been rotated, for example 4 5 6 7 8 9 0 1 2 3. If the midpoint and the target sit on different sides of the break, the midpoint is treated as very large or very small before a half is discarded.

routes.titleSuffix: 旋转且含重复的二分查找
routes.summary: 在旋转且含重复值的数组上演示二分查找：先跳过两端重复，再按旋转规则比较中点。
routes.introZh: 这一份同时处理旋转和重复。先跳过两端相同的值，再按旋转数组的规则比较中点。
routes.introEn: This variant handles both rotation and duplicates. Equal values at either end are skipped first, then the midpoint is compared with the rotated-array rule.

routes.summary: 逐步演示冒泡排序：相邻两项逆序就交换，每一趟把当前最大的数沉到末尾。可改序列，可播放、暂停、单步和变速。
routes.introZh: 从左到右比较相邻的两个数。左边更大就交换。一趟走完，最大的数落在这一趟的末尾，不再参与后面的比较。
routes.introEn: Compare each adjacent pair from left to right. Swap when the left value is larger. After a pass, the largest value of that pass sits at the end and stays there.
routes.complexityZh: 最坏和平均大约比较 n²/2 次。某一趟没有交换，就说明已经有序，可以提前结束，最好是 O(n)。
routes.complexityEn: Worst and average cases compare about n²/2 pairs. A pass with no swaps means the sequence is sorted, so the best case stops in O(n).

routes.summary: 逐步演示快速排序的划分：选末尾为枢轴，把较小的数换到左边，枢轴落到最终位置后再处理两侧。可改序列，可播放、暂停、单步和变速。
routes.introZh: 每次拿区间最右边的数当枢轴。比它小的数换到左段，然后把枢轴换到中间。枢轴就不再移动，左右两段各自重复。
routes.introEn: Each range takes its rightmost value as the pivot. Smaller values swap into the left side, then the pivot swaps into the middle and stays there. The two sides repeat.
routes.complexityZh: 平均时间 O(n log n)。每次都切成极不平衡的两段时，退化为 O(n²)。这里画出的调用深度平均是 O(log n)。
routes.complexityEn: Average time is O(n log n). Splits that are always unbalanced degrade to O(n²). The call depth drawn here is O(log n) on average.

routes.titleSuffix: 网格上的广度优先与深度优先
routes.summary: 在网格上逐步演示广度优先搜索和深度优先搜索：点格子改墙，看队列或栈如何扩展，直到走到终点或确认走不到。
routes.introZh: 从左上角出发，走到右下角。广度优先用队列，先扩展先遇到的格子，第一次到达终点就是最短路。深度优先用栈，沿一条路走到底再回头。
routes.introEn: Start at the top left and reach the bottom right. Breadth-first search uses a queue, so the first time it reaches the goal is a shortest path. Depth-first search uses a stack and follows one path to its end before backtracking.
routes.complexityZh: 每个格子最多进队列或栈一次。行数 R、列数 C，时间和额外空间都是 O(R×C)。
routes.complexityEn: Each cell enters the queue or stack at most once. With R rows and C columns, time and extra space are both O(R×C).

routes.summary: 在升序数组上用左右指针找两个数，使它们的和等于目标：和偏小就右移左指针，和偏大就左移右指针。可改序列和目标。
routes.introZh: 左指针从最小的数开始，右指针从最大的数开始。两端之和小于目标，说明左边太小，左指针右移；大于目标，右边太大，右指针左移。
routes.introEn: The left pointer starts at the smallest value and the right pointer at the largest. A sum below the target moves the left pointer right. A sum above the target moves the right pointer left.
routes.complexityZh: 数组必须先有序。两端相向移动，每个指针最多走 n 步，所以是 O(n)，只用常数空间。
routes.complexityEn: The array has to be sorted first. The pointers only move toward each other, at most n steps in total, so the scan is O(n) and uses constant space.

routes.summary: 逐步演示长度为 k 的滑动窗口：维护窗口和，右端前进一格时减去离开的数、加上新进入的数，并记下最大和。可改序列和 k。
routes.introZh: 先求出前 k 个数的和。窗口每向右滑一格，减去最左边离开的数，加上新进来的数，不必把窗口里的数重新加一遍。
routes.introEn: Start with the sum of the first k values. Each slide drops the value leaving on the left and adds the value entering on the right, without summing the window again.
routes.complexityZh: 每个数最多进窗口一次、出窗口一次，所以是 O(n)，只额外记下当前和与最大和。
routes.complexityEn: Each value enters and leaves the window at most once, so the scan is O(n), keeping only the current sum and the best sum.
